facts.fact: Egypt's MCIT, in its October 2005 information society report, says e-Signature Law No. 15, approved by Parliament in April 2004, gives electronic signatures the same legal merit as paper and is implemented by the new ITIDA, which licenses e-signature services.

note: The report states the law exists and ITIDA's licensing mandate; it names no licence granted or rules made.

claims.aftech-83df59c63e: nothing: information society report, not assessed
